name: Joyous Record
descriptionTemplate: "Strike" gains 2 Arithmetica and discards 1 random card; "Defense" draws 2 cards and loses 1 Arithmetica. Can be triggered up to 3 times per turn.
lore:
A record of the famous violinist's final performance.
Since then, it has been able to summon flames.
